methodologyNotes: Covers freshwater and saltwater fishing reels sold at a published US retail price, spanning spinning, low-profile baitcasting, spincast, conventional, and fly types. Excludes rod-and-reel combos, reel-less spools, and discontinued models. Price is typical US retail/MSRP in USD. reelType is the reel class (spinning | baitcasting | spincast | conventional | fly). reelSize is the manufacturer's size designation exactly as printed (e.g. 3000, 150, IV); null when the model ships in a single unnumbered size. gearRatio is the spool-to-handle ratio written X.X:1. maxDragLb is the rated maximum drag in pounds. lineRetrievePerTurnIn is line recovered per full handle turn in inches (IPT). bearingCount is the total count of ball bearings plus roller bearings. weightOz is reel weight in ounces. bodyMaterial is the frame/body material (aluminum | magnesium | graphite | carbon | composite). lineCapacityMono is monofilament capacity for the representative spool written as lb-test/yards. isSaltwaterRated is true when the manufacturer rates the reel as sealed or corrosion-resistant for saltwater use. Figures come from manufacturer spec sheets; where a series ships multiple sizes, the representative size is recorded per product.

products.name: Shimano Stella FK
products.priceNote: US MSRP $864.99 for the representative C3000XG size (SKU STLC3000XGFK), per Shimano's official specification chart (MSRP USD column: 864.99) and corroborated by Tackle Warehouse (Shimano Stella Spinning Reel C3000XGFK, Price: $864.99). Full series ranges $864.99-$894.99 across the five sizes (1000, 2500HG, C3000XG, 4000XG, C5000XG).
products.provenance: The official Shimano US product page (fish.shimano.com) confirms the exact model "Stella FK" as a front-drag spinning reel, and its specification chart lists the STLC3000XGFK (Stella C3000XG FK) representative size with gear ratio 6.4, max drag 20 lb, weight 7.4 oz, line retrieve per crank 37 in, 12/1 bearings, and MSRP USD 864.99. Tackle Warehouse corroborates the identical C3000XG size (Size: C3000XG, gear ratio 6.4:1, 37 inches per turn, 7.4 oz, mono 10/140, 12BB + 1RB) and lists the price at $864.99. Both pages identify this as the current Stella FK generation, confirming model identity; bodyMaterial is left null because neither page names a specific enum material (only "HAGANE Body / metal" and CI4+), and bearingCount 13 reflects the methodology sum of the printed "12/1" (12 ball + 1 roller).

products.name: Daiwa BG
products.priceNote: Tackle Warehouse lists the "Daiwa BG Spinning Reel 2500" (the recorded representative size) at "Price: $ 149.99" (US retail). The same page shows the series spanning "$149.99 - $159.99" across sizes 1500-3500. Manufacturer page (daiwa.us) lists no price.
products.provenance: Daiwa's official BG product page confirms model identity — the Daiwa BG series saltwater/freshwater spinning reel with an all-aluminum machined "Hard Bodyz" housing, oversized Digigear and carbon ATD drag — but publishes no per-size numbers or price. Tackle Warehouse's Daiwa BG page confirms the same reel and lists the representative BG2500 verbatim: gear ratio 5.6:1, 33.2 inches per turn, 9.3 oz weight, 6/210-8/170 mono line capacity, and a 6BB+1RB bearing system, priced at $149.99 US. Max drag (documented as 13.2 lb only on Amazon, which renders EUR/geo-blocked and is not cited) and an integer bearing count are not printed verbatim on either cited page, so both are left null rather than guessed.

products.name: Penn Battle IV
products.priceNote: US MSRP for the representative 4000 Standard Speed model (model # BTLIV4000) is $164.95, listed in the "Compare Models & Specs" table on the Penn manufacturer product page (pennfishing.com). The full Battle IV series ranges $144.95–$194.95 across sizes 1000–10000.
products.provenance: The Penn manufacturer product page (pennfishing.com) confirms the exact model "Battle IV Spinning Reel" and its per-size "Compare Models & Specs" table lists the representative 4000 Standard Speed (model # BTLIV4000) at gear ratio 6.2:1, 15 lb max drag, 6 ball bearings, mono capacity 270/8 220/10 165/12, and a US price of $164.95. The Fisherman's Headquarters retailer page corroborates the same BTLIV4000 model (6.2:1, 220/10 mono, 6 bearings, 15 lb drag) and adds the line retrieve of 37 in and weight of 12.2 oz that the manufacturer page omits. Both pages describe only a "Full Metal Body" without naming the metal, so bodyMaterial is left null; neither page states a release year, so releaseDate is null.

products.name: Okuma Ceymar
products.priceNote: US retail price $58.99 for the Okuma C-30 Ceymar per TackleDirect product page (shown as "Now: $58.99"). The Amazon C-30-CL listing was "Currently unavailable" with no live price, and no manufacturer MSRP is published on the fetched pages.
products.provenance: The Amazon "From the manufacturer" / Product Description block for the Okuma C-30-CL Ceymar reproduces Okuma's spec sheet verbatim, confirming this is the base Ceymar in size 30 (C-30) and stating gear ratio 5.0:1, 7BB+1RB ("8-bearing system"), 25" line retrieve, 13 lb max drag pressure, monofilament capacity 200/6·160/8·110/10 (yds/lb), graphite frame/side plates, aluminum spool, and 8.20 oz weight. TackleDirect's product page corroborates the exact model (Okuma C-30 Ceymar Spinning Reel, UPC 739998137169, corrosion-resistant graphite body) and provides the US retail price of $58.99. Okuma's own USA site is mid-migration/under construction and the manufacturer spec PDF returned non-extractable binary, so the manufacturer spec sheet is cited via Amazon's reproduced manufacturer content; both cited pages are the identical C-30 base Ceymar, not the Ceymar A or Ceymar HD variants.

products.name: Pflueger President
products.priceNote: US retail $74.95 as listed on the Pflueger manufacturer product page (pfluegerfishing.com) for the President Spinning Reel, and corroborated at $74.95 on Jann's Netcraft for the President PRESSP30 (size 30).
products.provenance: The Pflueger manufacturer page (pfluegerfishing.com) confirms this is the President Spinning Reel offered in sizes 20/25/30/35/40 at $74.95, and its model comparison table lists the size 30 (model PRES30X) with a 5.2:1 gear ratio, 10lb max drag, 10 ball bearings, 255/4 145/6 130/8 yds/lbs mono capacity, and a lightweight graphite body and rotor. Jann's Netcraft (President PRESSP30, size 30) corroborates the same model at $74.95 with matching gear ratio 5.2:1, mono capacity 4/255 6/145 8/130, and 9+1 (10) bearings, and additionally states the 8.8 oz weight and 25.3 in line-retrieve-per-crank not printed on the manufacturer page. Exact-model identity (President, size 30) is confirmed by the identical mono and braid line-capacity figures shared across both pages.

products.name: Abu Garcia Revo SX
products.priceNote: US retail $189.95, listed as "$189.95" on the Abu Garcia manufacturer product page (Revo SX Low Profile Reel, all four handle/gear variants) and corroborated at "$189.95" on the Tackle Warehouse product page.
products.provenance: The Abu Garcia manufacturer page (redirects to revo-sx-low-profile-reel-1573498) confirms this is the 5th-generation Revo SX Low Profile baitcast reel (model REVO5 SX LP), priced $189.95, listing a 6.7:1 representative gear ratio, 25 lb Power Stack Carbon Matrix max drag, and "9 stainless steel ball bearings +1 roller bearing" (10 total) — distinguishing it from the SX-SS (8.1:1) and SX Rocket (9.0:1) siblings. The Tackle Warehouse retailer page corroborates the $189.95 price and its Specifications table supplies the verbatim per-model figures for the standard 6.7:1 REVO5 SX LP: 29 inches per turn, 7.4 oz weight, 12/130 mono line capacity, and a 10-bearing (9SS+1RB) system. Tackle Warehouse also explicitly describes an "aluminum" / "Lightweight Aluminum Frame", and neither page rates the reel as sealed or corrosion-resistant for saltwater, so isSaltwaterRated is false.

products.name: Lew's Speed Spool LFS
products.priceNote: Fishermen's Source lists the Lew's SS1HLA Speed Spool LFS at "Sale price $99.95" (verbatim on the cited corroboration page). Corroborated by TackleDirect ("Now: $99.95") and the Wired2Fish review ("priced at just $100"). Recorded as typical US street price.
products.provenance: Lew's manufacturer product page confirms the Speed Spool baitcast line but is JavaScript-rendered, so no spec numbers surfaced; the exact model identity (Speed Spool LFS, SKU SS1HLA) is confirmed by the cited retailer listing and by Lew's own SS1A/SS1HA/SS1SHA/SS1HLA/SS1SHLA product manual. Fishermen's Source lists this exact SS1HLA model at "Sale price $99.95" with a per-model spec table stating 6.8:1 gear ratio, 9+1 bearings, 12/120 (12 lb / 120 yd) mono capacity, 15 lb max drag, and 7.1 oz weight — all matching Lew's manufacturer spec table as reproduced on Amazon. Body material is recorded as aluminum per Lew's manufacturer description ("one-piece aluminum frame with graphite palming sideplate"); the retailer's prose mislabels the frame as graphite, so that wording was not used, and IPT/line-retrieve was left null because it was not stated on the cited pages.

products.name: KastKing Sharky III
products.priceNote: KastKing.com store lists the Sharky III Spinning Reel priced by size: 1000 $55.99, 2000 $58.99, 3000 $61.99, 4000 $64.99, 5000 $67.99 (all 5.2:1). Recorded $67.99 for the representative 5000 size, verbatim on the manufacturer page ("5000 / 5.2:1 - $67.99"), no strikethrough/sale markdown shown. Amazon displayed the same listing only in EUR (List Price EUR 49.04) because this fetch resolved to a Germany delivery context, so no clean USD figure came from the retailer page.
products.provenance: The KastKing manufacturer page (source) confirmed the exact model "Sharky III Spinning Reel" and stated verbatim its 5.2:1 gear ratio, up to 39.5 LBs / 18KG triple-disc carbon-fiber drag, 10 + 1 saltwater-rated double-shielded stainless steel ball bearings, high-percentage fiber-reinforced graphite body/rotor, K.I.S.S. water-resistant sealing (saltwater rated), and per-size USD store prices including the 5000 at $67.99. The Amazon page (corroboration) matched the same Sharky III variant (Color "5.2:1-Sharky III"), reproducing the 39.5 lb carbon-fiber drag, "Bearing Number 11", sizes 1000-5000, and the "New for 2018" release note; a verified size-5000 review independently listed Max Drag 39.5lbs for that exact size, supporting the representative-size choice. maxDragLb 39.5 and reelSize 5000 are internally consistent because 39.5 lb is the series maximum, achieved on the 5000; weightOz, lineRetrievePerTurnIn, and lineCapacityMono were left null since only a customer review (not a manufacturer spec sheet) stated them.

products.name: 13 Fishing Concept A3
products.priceNote: Manufacturer 13 Fishing (Rapala) product page for the Concept A3 Baitcast Reel lists "From $219.99" (US). Figure recorded verbatim; represents the starting price across the A3 configurations (representative model here is the 8.1:1, CA3-8.1-RH). The American Offshore retailer page priced it only in EUR (€222,95), so was not used for USD.
products.provenance: The 13 Fishing (Rapala) manufacturer product page confirmed the exact model — the Concept A3 Baitcast Reel — and its spec table lists the representative 8.1:1 configuration (CA3-8.1-RH) with max drag 40 lbs, 7 bearings, weight 10.3 / 9.8 oz, line capacity 12/240, and a starting price "From $219.99"; the American Offshore retailer page independently confirmed CA3-8.1-RH at 8.1:1 with weight 9.8 oz (resolving the dual-weight listing), 40 lbs, 7 bearings, and 12/240. The Bassmaster gear review corroborated the exact Concept A3 model and uniquely supplied the 8.1:1 line-retrieve rate of 37 inches per crank, plus seven ball bearings and the HD aluminum frame with Ocean Armor 2 saltwater protection. lineCapacityMono is null because the stated 12/240 is explicitly 12-lb braid (per the review), not monofilament, and reelSize is null because the A3 ships as a single unnumbered low-profile size.

products.name: Orvis Mirage LT
products.priceNote: No single verbatim per-size MSRP is stated, so priceUsd is left null. The Orvis manufacturer page (item #2MTS) displays a size-dependent price range of "$449 - $598" for the Mirage LT Reel; the AvidMax retailer page shows a selling range of "$429.00 - $598.00". Both figures appear verbatim on the respective fetched pages but neither maps a specific dollar figure to the representative size III.
products.provenance: The Orvis manufacturer page (item #2MTS, titled "Mirage LT Lightweight Fly Reel") confirms this exact model as a fly reel machined from 6061 T6 aluminum, offered in sizes LT I-IV, with size III (line weights 5-7) weighing "4.5 oz"; it lists a size-dependent price of "$449 - $598". AvidMax (retailer) corroborates the identical model — 6061 T6 aluminum construction, sealed/maintenance-free carbon and stainless-steel disc drag, four sizes I-IV — and shows a "$429.00 - $598.00" selling range. Both pages explicitly position the LT for lighter freshwater rods (trout, bass, pike, musky, carp) rather than saltwater, so isSaltwaterRated is false; no gear ratio, max drag, line retrieve/IPT, bearing count, or monofilament capacity is stated on either page, so those keys are left null.
